objective: Reduce Geometry/Construction, Vegetation/Natural Complexity and Weathering deduction risk at the mature-tree root-zone interface without awarding visual points before real native Unity evidence exists.

discovery.risk: The previous decorative-scale opening could allow mature generated root flares to meet curb/paving, while three of four maintained rings placed every curb at one plaza-derived elevation even when modules were supported by lower lawn. Paved understory origins were also high relative to a near-flush root-zone surface. These are potential visible floating/interpenetration defects in oblique/grazing 4K crops.

implemented.runtimeRootClearanceMethod: transform and inspect every actual root-flare mesh vertex for generated fallbacks

materialReasoning.weatheringPolicy: ordinary compaction, pedestrian pressure, runoff/dust and exposure only; no arbitrary damage narrative or baked contact lighting

selfAuditCorrections.initialIssue: The first draft sized the opening from the nominal 0.58 tip ratio alone.
selfAuditCorrections.correction: Inspected the authored tapered-segment generator, accounted for 8 percent radial irregularity/lateral offset with a conservative normalized tip envelope of 0.64, increased opening radius from 1.15 to 1.16 m, and added exact transformed-vertex runtime QA.

selfAuditCorrections.initialIssue: The first root-zone refinement passed the desired final soil thickness directly into GetBeveledCylinder Y.
selfAuditCorrections.correction: Inspected QualityBlockDetailMeshLibrary and confirmed its Y input mirrors Unity's legacy cylinder half-height convention. The pass now supplies half of the final 57.5 mm soil visual thickness (28.75 mm), preventing an unintended double-height soil slab.

scores.expectedVisualScoreImpact: Potential deduction-risk reduction in Geometry & Construction, Vegetation/Natural Complexity, Weathering/Context Causality and Temporal/LOD stability; intentionally not converted into points without rendered evidence.

nextBlocker: A Unity 6000.3.0f1 runner remains required. On first real runner/capture, stop speculative expansion and execute the complete native-4K packet; inspect oblique/vegetation_grounding, grazing/tree_shadow_contact and hero/ground_contact at 100 percent for root/curb intersection, local curb bearing, soil-lip visibility, soil underside gaps, stem grounding, dielectric material response, repeated module pattern and LOD/shimmer defects.
